gen-irish-grover-plus-jakarta-sans: Playful and sturdy, Irish Grover stands tall with soft, uneven strokes that feel hand-shaped. Plus Jakarta Sans sits beside it in clean sans lines, precise and hairline-free.
gen-jetbrains-mono-gf-epunda-slab: Dignified Epunda Slab, a text serif with a gaping c and rounded lowercase, carries the reading. And JetBrains Mono up top stays loose and fixed-width, so give the body a little extra size.
gen-jetbrains-mono-gf-esteban: Esteban has a text serif's sturdy thin lines and a lowercase that looks oversized beside its capitals. Esteban pairs with JetBrains Mono's pressure-free, code-style letters; a slightly larger size lets that wide e open up.
gen-jetbrains-mono-gf-fauna-one: JetBrains Mono strings out fixed-width letters with open, scissor-blade terminals, drawn like a ballpoint line. Fauna One, a classic serif with a tall middle band and shallow ascenders, is the one built for sustained reading.
gen-jetbrains-mono-gf-faustina: Authoritative Faustina, a classic serif, has an open-jawed c and bowls that thin gracefully. And JetBrains Mono's laser-etched, constant-width line keeps the headings crisp, so extended text feels steady and unhurried.
gen-jetbrains-mono-gf-glegoo: Glegoo reads big and open, with wide counters and unclosed curves. JetBrains Mono is best at crisp, single-width lines like vinyl cut for a sign, while Glegoo, a classic serif, handles the editorial reading.
gen-jetbrains-mono-gf-halant: JetBrains Mono draws its fixed-width letters with the weight of a drawn wire and loose spacing. Halant, a classic serif with outward-pointing terminals and a towering x-height, adds a faint thick-thin shift that gives the headings something to lean against.
gen-jetbrains-mono-gf-hanuman: Traditional Hanuman, a classic serif with a high-waisted lowercase, takes over where the heading stops. Hanuman has low contrast to match JetBrains Mono's zero-contrast, code-style strokes, so the two sit comfortably together.
gen-jetbrains-mono-gf-headland-one: Dignified Headland One, a serif with gently modulated strokes and a tall rounded o, sits under JetBrains Mono's uniform, loosely strung capitals. Give the body a modest bump in size.
gen-jetbrains-mono-gf-hedvig-letters-ser: Hedvig Letters Serif reads sturdy and open, with tall lowercase bodies and curves that have room to breathe against JetBrains Mono's monoline stems. Its medium contrast is the pair's best quality.
